title: Practice 20: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I despise this music.
exercises.why: **презирать → презираю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Том ___ (проходить) военную службу в рядах авиации.
exercises.prompt: Tom is doing his military service in the air force.
exercises.why: **проходить → проходит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why are you crumbling this bread?
exercises.why: **крошить → крошите** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why do mosquito bites itch?
exercises.why: **чесаться → чешутся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Why are you undressing?
exercises.why: **раздеваться → раздеваешься** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The baby is teething now.
exercises.why: **резаться → режутся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: An emptiness devours my heart.
exercises.why: **пожирать → пожирает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: What do you plant in these fields?
exercises.why: **засевать → засеваете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Иджипт Эйр ежедневно ___ (осуществлять) один вылет из Нью Йорка в Каир.
exercises.prompt: Egyptair has one daily flight from New York to Cairo.
exercises.why: **осуществлять → осуществляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: A man walks into a bar...
exercises.why: **заходить → Заходит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я уже чувствую, как у меня пульс ___ (ускоряться).
exercises.prompt: I can feel my pulse quickening already.
exercises.why: **ускоряться → ускоряется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I usually cut the crust off bread.
exercises.why: **срезать → срезаю** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Элай по порядку ___ (рассказывать) об увиденном и услышанном.
exercises.prompt: Elay is relating, step by step, what she saw and heard.
exercises.why: **рассказывать → рассказывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The moon moves around the earth.
exercises.why: **вращаться → вращается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Старый пруд. Лягушка ___ (прыгать) в него. Всплеск воды.
exercises.prompt: An old pond. A frog jumps in. The sound of water.
exercises.why: **прыгать → прыгает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Mary is playing solitaire.
exercises.why: **раскладывать → раскладывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Smoke is rising from the chimney.
exercises.why: **подниматься → поднимается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I suppose you're right.
exercises.why: **предполагать → предполагаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Does iron react with sodium?
exercises.why: **реагировать → реагирует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: There is an album on the desk.
exercises.why: **лежать → лежит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
